212210001:
[Daily] Glittering Fairy Wings	[Daily] Glittering Fairy Wings	Collect Glittering Fairy Dust.	"Client: Sascha

You said you were from Ocean Island. I assume you've seen the fairy with beautiful sparkling wings that lives on the cliffs.
Her name is Naiad and she's the queen of the Bancies. 
Her wings shed dust that sparkles like gold.

212210002:
[Daily] Sticky Mushroom	[Daily] Sticky Mushroom	Collect Lethal Mushroom Spores.	"Client: Zilbert

I'm conducting a research project. 
It's in its home stretch now, after 5 years of trial and error. One more experiment, and I'll be done with it. The objective of the experiment is to see if my medicine can neutralize a poison that can kill a grown man however small the dose. 
But it's impossible to find such a potent poison in Jawaii. I'm thinking to formulate my own poison, and for that I need the mushroom Spores from Blop that lives on Ocean Island. 
Please help me with my research."			Thank you! Finally my research will come to fruition!
212210003:
[Daily] Greedy Captain Vadon	[Daily] Greedy Captain Vadon	Collect Lost Bundle from Captain Vadon.	"Client: Zorno

You know... About Ocean Island. 
Isn't there a giant crab? Sure, everything on Ocean Island is giant, but this crab I'm talking about is really big. 
If you ask me how big, Um... it might be bigger than this house. Anyway, back to the point. The crab lives in the wreckage that is filled with lots of things. 
You know that, right? Oh, you don't. Well, never mind, then. 
That crab stands sentry on the wreckage.  
And that's my predicament. Last time I went there to see if I could find some useful things, only to lose mine. I don't doubt the giant crab has my things, but it scares me to no end... 
Don't you get it? 
I want you to find my belongings, and I think that crab has them."			"Oh, thank you! 
Ah, I don't want to sound ungrateful, but I lost more than just this bundle. Are you sure this was the only thing you could find? 
Ah, never mind then. I just wanted to make sure."
212210004:
[Daily] Saddened Ruler of Ocean Island	[Daily] Saddened Ruler of Ocean Island	Defeat Swamp Hunter.	"Client: Edi

A part of Ocean Island is colder than the rest. 
No, not the swamp; it's damp and creepy, but not cold. Anyway, back to the point: that place is inhabited by a monster that once ruled the entire island. 
It used to live in the swamp, but it had to leave after being pushed down the pecking order by Blop. Why am I talking about the monster, you ask? because there's a problem 
with the energy that the monster radiates. 
Originally that monster was a giant cluster of positive energy. It used to charge the air with its positive energy wherever it went. But since Blop, it's been overwhelmed with so much anger and shame that its entire existence has changed for the worse. 
Now its negative energy is affecting the rest of the monsters on the island. 
So far its positive energy accumulated in the air outdoes the negative, but that's not going to last long. 
That monster needs to go. 
But it once ruled Ocean Island. You can guess how strong it is. 
You can't fight the monster alone. You'll need at least a few reliable comrades with you. Are you up for it?"			"That creature once was favored by the Goddess. I have a feeling it'll be reborn. I hope in its next life, it will forget all the bad memories and fill itself with nothing but positive energy."
212210005:
[Daily] Firm Delicious Crab Meat	[Daily] Firm Delicious Crab Meat	Collect Meaty Crab Legs from Vadon Families.	"Client: Marthe

I want to eat some crab meat. 
When I was young, Dad brought home a crab, and it was so delicious that I still remember its taste. 
Crabs don't live in Jawaii, and the closest thing to a crab is the Vadon Families living on Ocean Island. They look like crabs, so I'm guessing they should taste like crabs, too. 
What do you think? 
Then could you get me some legs from Vadon Families?"			Whoa! These legs are big and meaty!
212210006:
[Daily] Cause of Insomnia	[Daily] Cause of Insomnia	Defeat Giant Whisper.	"Client: Wilhelm

A while ago I dropped by Ocean Island to take care of some business. 
I hadn't visited the island for a while, so I decided to look around and discovered some dark place. My curiosity got me, so I looked closer – there were ghosts flying in the air! I was scared witless. 
I'm so fainthearted that I can't sleep at night without a light on. Guess what would have happened to me after I saw those ghosts. 
I passed out on the ground for half the day! 
Living and breathing the same air as such scary beings... Well, strike that; they're dead. 
Anyway, just thinking about living in the same space as those ghosts gives me the creeps. 
I haven't slept well since I saw them, and I feel exhausted all day. I have a feeling that those ghosts come in to my room and pester me while I'm sleeping.
Please get rid of them. 
Or I might die from lack of sleep!"			I feel lighter as if a burden has lifted off my shoulders. I knew it: those ghosts had been haunting me!

Do you see that? The roof of my house is in need of repair. 
There are monsters called Mejonoras on Ocean Island, and some of them look wet and firm. Their leaves are particularly tough and strong. 
Those leaves are also resistant to moisture, which makes them a perfect roof material. Could you bring me the Moist Leaves? 
My roof is on the verge of caving in."			They're as strong as I expected! But they're too wet. I'd better dry them in the sun first.

Is that true that Ocean Island is filled with gigantic mosquito-like creatures?

Jawaii Ocean Island is infested with star-shaped monsters that live on fish. 
They're big and they have a voracious appetite. Sometimes they even break my fishing nets to eat the fishes within. 
Not only are they damaging to my business

Sometimes on a clear night I see some blue and red lights dancing in the air around Ocean Island. 
I'm thinking they're Will-o-the-wisps, right? They have to be really big to be seen so clearly from this far away. 
I'm a light sleeper, so even the tiniest flicker of light can wake me up. 
The weather has been clear for days, meaning the Will-o-the-wisps on Ocean Island have been clearly visible, ergo my sleepless nights.

Some cats live on Ocean Island, and they have sticky paws; they keep stealing from our village. 
It's a mystery, though, how they come to this village island because Ocean Island is not in swimming distance. 
I wouldn't have minded sharing some food with those cats, but they steal all the shiny things. 
Someone needs to teach them a lesson not to steal from others. Could you do that? 
Ocean Island is overrun with those cats. Just grab a few and make an example of them.
It'll be great if you can bring back what they stole too."			"Sigh, these are not even half the things that they have stolen from us."

Around this time of the year mushrooms start releasing their Spores into the air. 
I like eating mushrooms, but I hate those monstrous Spores on Ocean Island.

I'm thinking of culling the monstrous Spores before they spawn those terrible-tasting mushrooms.

[Daily] Eliminating the Cause	[Daily] Eliminating the Cause	Defeat Sticky Spores.	"Client: Quadro

The stench! Only those who smelled it understand the atrocity. 
I want to get rid of those Sticky Spores before they spawn the stinky mushrooms.

[Daily] Her New Toy	[Daily] Her New Toy	Collect Prince's Crown.	"Client: Alina

I played princess with my friends, and they wanted me to be the witch. 
I said, ""But I want to be the princess!"" They said, ""But you don't have the crown."" 
They wouldn't even let me borrow one of their crowns. Selfish brats! 
Pfft! 
I asked them if they would let me play the princess if I brought a crown. They snorted at me because they knew I didn't have a crown. 
<charname>, one of the stags on Ocean Island is wearing a crown. 
Could you bring its crown to me? Pfft!
I want to show those brats that I have a real crown, not a paper crown like theirs!"			One of the brats dropped her crown in the water.

[Daily] Fruit Growing on the Head	[Daily] Fruit Growing on the Head	Collect fruits from Wild Deer.	Client: Veronika

Have you seen those deer with plants growing on their heads? 
The word is that the plants bear delicious fruit. Could you bring me the fruit?
I want to see if they are really as tangy and juicy as people say they are.			"Oh, This is it! 
I can smell their sweet fragrance even from this far away!"
212210018:
[Daily] Flint	[Daily] Flint	Collect Hot Fairy Dust.	"Client: Roza

We people of Jawaii use special ashes to make fire easily. 
We pile a mound of the ashes and strike two stones together above it, and voila! A fire has started. 
I spilled mine by accident. It happened while I was on the beach, and the waves swept away the ashes. 
The ashes are of plants that grow only during a certain time of the year, and that time has passed. 
There's only so much ash I can borrow from my neighbors until next year. 
I did some research and found out that the Bancies on Ocean Island shed flammable dust. 
Could you bring their dust to me?"			This dust feels hot to the touch. I'd better handle it with gloves on.

[Daily] Fight Poison with Poison	[Daily] Fight Poison with Poison	Collect Poisonous Claws.	"Client: Veronika

Ah, my baby must have eaten something bad. It's having stomach cramps. 
There's nothing like the ground claws of the Ocean Island salamanders that gets rid of stomach pain. 
It's funny, the ground claws is lethal when ingested any other times except for stomach pain. 
Could you get me a few claws from the salamanders? My aged spine can't handle a boat ride."			This will work like charm on my cute little puppy's tummy ache! Thank you.

213000520:
Magnificent Castle in the Sky	Magnificent Castle in the Sky	Speak with Dr. Jacob.	"Look, there! Over there! Do you see that huge castle?
That castle floating in the sky. That's Valkyrie Himmelmez's Castle.
It's also called the Dark Whisper.
They say that no one who entered there has come back alive!
About a month ago, I heard that a huge object appeared in Morocc sky, so I came here to satisfy my curiosity.
And then I found it...
I've found out that the unknown colossal object that appeared in Morocc sky is Valkyrie Himmelmez's Air Fortress!
Valkyrie Himmelmez's Castle. Yes! Since learning about  Dark Whisper, I've started building a plan to infiltrate  Dark Whisper.
And after observing it for about a week, I've learned a way to get in there.
The servants in Dark Whisper come down to Midgard to capture slaves.
Well, the servants  either lie to poor people that they have a job for them, or they just kidnap the villagers.
Knowing this, I joined the group entering Dark Whisper and was able to get in there without any suspicion.
 I planted a machine there so we can now go in and out without being detected."			"Well, I succeeded in getting into Dark Whisper, but the problem was getting out. 
Hey, I almost became one of those Skull Walkers and spend the rest of my mortal life mining ores!"
213000530:
The Ultimate Merge Experimentalist	The Ultimate Merge Experimentalist	Speak with Dr. Jacob.	"Luckily, I was able to get out with the help from an Ashkaron Empire Knight. <charname>!!
I need your help.
There's a legend that among the 12 Valkyries, all have been killed on the Day of Despair except for Randgris, but no one knows for sure.
Who knows? Maybe all 12 are still alive. Look, even Himmelmez is still alive, right?
Or maybe the Freyjanity have done something unspeakable... 
Anyway, we must stop Valkyrie Himmelmez's experiment.
The biological experiment conducted by the Freyjanity is being done on the orders of Himmelmez!
<charname>!! We must not let another innocent person become a victim of such cruel experiment!"			Ashkaron Empire Knights will provide you with needed support.
213000540:
Entering the Dark Whisper	Entering the Dark Whisper	Take the Portal and go to the Lower Level of the Dark Whisper.	Go and prepare yourself before leaving for Dark Whisper. 
I'm going to go ahead first and scout things out.
			"Oh, you're here!
This place is called the Lower Level.
I was talking to this Knight here before you arrived, and learned quite a lot about this place.
This is the place where Himmelmez locks up his experiment specimens.
Well, to be more precise, the subjects of those experiments that didn't go well are locked up here."
213000560:
A Letter from the Husband and the Father (2)	A Letter from the Husband and the Father (2)	Speak with Rike.	"What? A letter for me?
From who.... Mar... M... Martin???!!
Oh Odin! A letter from Martin!!
Did he come here with you? Where's Martin? He's all right, isn't he? Isn't he?!?!?!!!"			"Ah... you didn't get the letter from him...
I see... Oh, my poor Martin! If only I didn't complain and nag him so much that day..."
213000570: Hey! Come here!	Hey! Come here!	You need to talk to Max.	"This is your first time in Dark Whisper, right? How did I know? You looking around all big-eyed like that, it's like  you've got a huge sign board that says ""I'm New Here!!"" over your head!\nI have no idea what you were thinking coming up here but if you want to stay alive, you'd better get out of here quickly. There's nothing but hideous and terrifying monsters here.\nBut, if for whatever reason you need to stay, then why not work with me? I'm a pretty well known monster hunter. I'm here at the request from the survivors in Ashkaron Empire, and I can use a hand. Well? How about it? Want to give it a shot?"			Great! I can see the change in your eyes. It seems like you've set your mind on accomplishing something here. That's good. That means I can trust you to watch my back.
213000580:
Preparation is key to success!	Preparation is key to success!	You must get the Stone of Hellacoup and bring it to Max.	"My objective here is to search for any survivors from the Ashkaron Empire and help them to return home safely.
I've found the survivors but they insist that they will not go back home until Himmelmez is dead. That's pretty much beyond my ability and it kind of messes up my plan.
I've decided to stick around here for awhile and help out the Ashkaron Empire Knights. The least I can do is help them stay alive.
We are resting now because the attacks from monsters have slowed down a bit, but we can't just sit around forever since they can just rush in at any moment.
I must do something to be prepared. Hey, you can help me by getting some of those stones near the Hellacoups. I think those stones will be perfect for reinforcing the defense line."		Don't trust ANYONE in here. Watch out for your own neck here.	"These stones will pretty good. Hellacoups are probably all worked up now because they've got their stones taken.
I wouldn't go back there for awhile if I were you. Once the stones are removed from their bodies, Hellacoups become really violent."
213000590:
Get rid of the smell!	Get rid of the smell!	You must spread perfume on the stones near the Hellacoups.	"By the way, did you cover up your tracks on your way back here? If those Hellacoups got your scent, they'll surely track you down here to come after their stones. What? Cover what up? Oh Odin! What was I expecting from a rookie?
Here, take this and spray it around the stones nearby Hellacoups.
This is a perfume made of scents Hellacoups like. Spray this and it will get them feeling good and forget about your scent. All you have to do is just spray it on the stones. Simple, right?"		"Get rid of your scent! Trust me, it will save your life!"	"Kkkk... did you spray the stones? Those stones are actually their poops, but to us, it's nothing but a rock so don't think of it dirty.
They only eat rocks all day, so even their poops are rocks."
213000600:
Leather & Stone	Leather & Stone	Collect Hellacoups' stones and leather and bring them to Max.	Hey.. you know? I like the way you work. And I've found a way to make some side money. How? Hellacoups' leather and stones. I've noticed that their leather is strong and warm. I think we can sell them at good price to the clothes merchants.
And those stones you brought back... the designs and patterns on them look very rare and somewhat collectible. I'm sure those dumb nobles will buy them up no matter how much we ask for them.
So eliminate the Hellacoups and bring back their leather and stones. I'll buy them off you at good price.		I think we can make a lot of money if we play things right here.	"Great! This will fetch pretty good profit. I'm certain that the merchants will pay well for high quality leather like this.
And of course, those dumb nobles who love rare things will pay handsomely for these stones as well."
213000610: Troublesome Individual	Troublesome Individual	You need to talk to Nathaniel.	"Hey, if you're not that busy, can you do me a favor and take this Order to Nathaniel? Yea, I can go but I don't really want to see his face. I don't know when he'll come around but... hew... anyway, please take this over to him. Oh, and please tell him that the Commander will make his life miserable if he ignores the orders again."			"And who may you be? Oh, don't bother. I really don't care if you're the King! Who knows? Today may be the last day of my life.."
213000620:
Orders? Take that to someone who cares!	Orders? Take that to someone who cares!	You need to talk to Ron Kaisar.	What's that? Orders? Let's see... what? This is it? Eliminate the Cave Worms?
Go and tell Ron that I said stop issuing these useless orders but send me the order I'm waiting for.
(But Ron said you'll be in trouble with the Commander if you don't follow that order.)
Trouble? Look around! Do you think I'm worried about punishment from the Commander? You tell Ron exactly what I say. I'm not scared of death so send me to Arwen ASAP.			"Hmm... he still hasn't come around yet, has he?
(What's the problem?)
Well... he's looking for death.
(What do you mean?)"
213000630:
Noble Sacrifice	Noble Sacrifice	Eliminate the Cave Worms and talk to Ron Kaisar.	"A while ago, we were on a mission to eliminate Arwen. We had Arwen trapped and thought we were going to succeed but it was actually a trap to lure us in, all planned by that evil arachnid monster.
We should've known something was wrong, but it was already too late by the time we realized that. As a result, we suffered heavy casualties and while we were retreating, Rachel, Nathaniel's friend sacrificed herself and covered the rear so that we could escape.
We are all saddened for Rachel's sacrifice, but Nathaniel...
He believes that Rachel is dead because of him since it's Nathaniel's duty as the rear-guard to cover the retreat. But he was wounded by Arwen during the mission and Rachel covered for him.
Since then, he has been fixated on going back to kill Arwen. But because of the heavy loss the Knights have suffered, the Commander is treating that part very carefully. But Nathaniel... that stubborn soldier's mind is all filled with rage, and he is not thinking of anything else but revenge.
Commander understands him and he has been letting things go by but it has gone too far now, and it's now becoming a morale issue for the entire Battalion. I don't think the Commander will let the insubordination go by this time..
Hey, if you're not so busy, can you do this mission for him? He's not a bad soldier. And I don't want him to get kicked out of the Knights Battalion for disobeying orders. His order is to eliminate the Cave Worms. I'm sure you can beat the worms. So can you do that for me?"		"I know that eliminating the Cave Worms is not that easy. But please, we can't let Nathaniel get kicked out of the Battalion."	"I got this mission done thanks to your help, but it doesn't solve my problem. I'm not sure what I can do since I can't keep on asking others to cover for Nathaniel."
213000640:
Rachel's Belongings	Rachel's Belongings	Collect Rachel's belongings and then talk to Nathaniel.	"The only way to bring Nathaniel back to his senses is to find Rachel's remains and bring them to Nathaniel.
The last I saw of her as we retreated was her swinging her swords courageously and charging towards Arwen. I'm pretty sure that she was killed by Arwen himself.
I have no doubt that Odin has blessed and guided her soul, but maybe Arwen might still have her remains or her belongings.
Arwen has a habit of collecting trophies from his victims.
If you kill Arwen and find Rachel's belongings, please bring it to Nathaniel. Then maybe, just maybe, he will come to his senses."			"This is... it's Rachel's necklace. Where... how... oh... Rachel…
Did you kill Arwen? I needed to do that... Ron asked you, right?
You know, I'm fortunate to have friends like him. I think it's time to let go now. Thanks to you, I'm sure Rachel can rest peacefully now. Thank you."
213000650:
Knights' Remains	Knights' Remains	Collect the remains of fallen Knights and bring them to Noah.	"We never forget our fallen comrades. If we don't remember those who have sacrificed their lives for the honor of the Empire, then who else will? Although they could not return back to the Empire alive, we must bring something back that reminds us of each of those who have perished. That's why I am searching for their remains and their belongings.
If you find anything that belongs to a fallen Knight, then please bring it back to me.
I cannot reward you much but I will give you something useful for each remain you bring back."		"We can't leave our fallen comrades in a place like this. We will continue to search for their remains, until we find every one of them."	"Thank you. Ashkaron Empire will not forget your help.
If you ever need our help, don't hesitate. We will do whatever we can to help you."
213000660:
Supply Heist	Supply Heist	Steal the supplies and bring them to Noah.	"I am looking for volunteers for a supply heist mission. Are you interested?
There's a monster called Chef Gurushi here in the Upper Level. His chamber is filled with piles of food supplies for Himmelmez, and we're looking for volunteers to form a team and go steal those supplies.
It's a difficult mission that requires luck as well. Chef Gurushi is a very powerful monster, and if you every come face to face with him alone, you'd better run like you've never ran before.
Since it's a highly dangerous mission, anyone who joins the team will be promised with deserving reward. Well? Are you interested?"		It will be wise to move in while Gurushi steps out.	"You've succeeded! Glad you came back alive.
Oh, the conditions of the supplies looks to be excellent. I think our Knight Battalion won't have to worry about food for quite a while."
213000670:
Shot of Whiskey is What you Need!	Shot of Whiskey is What you Need!	Get Morodona and bring it to Eron.	"I've heard that there's some good liquor in Morocc. What was it called? Mo..rado? Monalisa? Oh, yea! Morodona! That's it! Everyone in Ashkaron Knights Battalion knows that I'm quite an aficionado of liquor. A few, very few let me remind you, call me drunkard, but I don't let that bother me.
Savoring a tasty liquor sliding down your tongue... ah! There's nothing in the world that can match that feeling.
Anyway, do you think you can bring me a bottle of Morodona from time to time, when I ask you for the favor?"		"If there's a good liquor out there, I'll pay anything to get a taste of it."	"Yes! This is it! Just look at this beautiful emerald glow and smell that delectable scent. Oh, my mind is buzzing already. Hey, let's keep this secret between you and me, OK?
If the Commander finds out about this, he'll hang me for sure!"
213000680: Battle to Free the Slaves	Battle to Free the Slaves	"Eliminate Skull Miners and Skull Walkers, then speak with Nathaniel."	"If you go to the large chamber south from here, there are monsters called Skull Miners and Skull Walkers in there. Those monsters were actually citizens of the Empire. The boss monster called Gustaff abducted our people and enslaved them. And as if that wasn't enough, those who died while enslaved were transformed into monsters so that Gustaff can continue to get them to work forever.\nAlthough they are now monsters, they were once the people of our great Empire. We can't just sit around and do nothing while their souls are suffering from never ending slavery.\nPlease, give them eternal peace so that their souls can rest now."		It's sad that the only way to provide them peace is to kill them.	Thank you. At least their souls will now have eternal rest.
213000690: Two Beasts	Two Beasts	"Eliminate the Sharanka and Epika, and talk to Ron Kaisar."	"In order to eliminate the Wolf Trainer Kurolff, you must pass through a small chamber on the path that leads north from here. Inside are monsters known as Sharanka and Epika, and we are looking for a volunteer who will eliminate those monsters.\nThese monsters are incomparably stronger than other Hellacoups, so we've placed a special reward for their heads. But if you're a novice, I recommend that you sit this one out and stay alive."		"If it's too difficult for you, it's more wise to wait to fight in another day."	"Amazing! Those two monsters were trained by Kurolff himself, and are incomparably stronger than other monsters.\nOh, I almost forgot. Here's the reward as promised."
213000700: Small Spider	Small Spider	You must eliminate Argos and talk to Dr. Jacob.	"Have you ever seen a small spider called Argos? They store venom on their back to use for hunting or when they are in danger. Well, that venom is so powerful, it is known to melt even rocks. I don't know why my scientific mind gets all excited when I hear something like that, but I must study that poison. So, can you please help me?\nIt's not that difficult.  <charname>, I'm going to look around here. Would you check out the inner area?"			"That... it can't be!!!!

 She began sacrificing her body at a young age in order to increase her occult powers.

259000010:
Diamond-charmer	Diamond-charmer	Speak with Cheny.	Have you ever heard about Cheny? No?! How come?!

She’s a norman who once lived at the Svartalf continent. She learned about a special currency they have there – the diamonds – and about a Niddavellir magic of changing the appearance of clothes! You should check it out if you’re interested in this kind of stuff!			"Hey! Welcome to Cheny’s not-so-secret shop! The rumors seem to have made me famous.

Huh? You want to know more about the diamonds?
What can I say…
At Niddavellir, they usually get diamonds from mining activities and use them as an alternative currency. They give Diamonds for those they judge worthy, may it be for your intelligence or for your muscles. Anyhow, you can exchange any diamonds you get with my little friend there to transmogrify old equipment into your clothes. Oh, you don’t know what is transmogrification either? 

You’ll always have to change your equipment for better ones, right? They can be stronger, but sometimes you feel that they don’t suit you like your former clothes. The transmogrification is for cases like this; you can change the appearance of your current equipment to match ANY equipment! Isn’t it awesome? Oh, of course the equipment should as the same race and gender as yours for it work.

You can buy scrolls from the guys wearing green armor. They’re always somewhere wanting to slay something. But you’ll need some diamonds to buy their scrolls first. Don’t ask me why you need diamonds to get more diamonds! They’re all weirdos! By the way, here are some Diamonds for you. It’s a one-time special. This you can get some diamonds from them and then come back to us later and spend it on something else! "
259000020:
Leprechaun Fan-Club (1)	Leprechaun Fan-Club (1)	Speak with Vanity Merchant.	You can do many things with diamonds besides transmogrification – like buying nice things from me! - but one of the coolest things about transmogrification is certainly the Vanity equipment. Why don’t you ask one of Leprechaun’s Fan Club members over there? He will tell you more about it.			"You want to know more about the Vanity equipment? Sure.

You can change the appearance of your equipment into any of the vanity equipment you buy from me, if of course, you’re from the same gender and race as the equipment you bought. The Vanity Equipment are made especially for the transmogrification process. They are highly customizable and look good on everyone!

But beware! Vanity Equipment are meant to be used only on the transmogrification process, what means that they don’t offer you any stats like normal equipment."
259000030:
Leprechaun Fan-Club (2)	Leprechaun Fan-Club (2)	Speak with Costume Merchant.	"If you happen to gain vanity equipment or special costumes and don’t like its appearance, you can always buy some Magic Wrapping Paper from Cheny and disassemble it to receive some pieces back.

Talking about special costumes, why don’t you ask the Costume Merchant about them?

Goodbye!"			"My, my! You’re here to hear about the special costumes, aren’t you?

You can exchange with me your Pieces of Leprechaun’s Dress into cute costumes! These costumes are… costumes. I mean, you can’t use them to transmogrify themn into your equipment. Of course, you can only transmogrify equipment into your equipment! Costumes go into different slots and overlaps only the looks of your equipment, without losing any stat points at all."
259000040:
Leprechaun Fan-Club (3)	Leprechaun Fan-Club (3)	Speak with Aura Merchant.	"But Leprechaun Pieces are somewhat rare to come by. That’s one of the reasons we treasure them so much… You can get some from the Leprechaun’s Cube, by the way. If you ever get a good amount of them, bring them to me and I’ll reward you with some really cute costumes. You can also get some decoration accessories from the Theme Accessory Merchant if you wish. The only bad thing about costumes is that, unlike equipment, you can’t put any aura on them.

Wait, don’t tell me you know nothing about auras yet! Oh my! Go ask the aura merchant then! He’s just over there."			"Here to get some auras? Huh? You don’t know about the auras? Oh c'mon! Huh, don’t worry, I’ll tell you about them. 

Auras are magical cosmetic effects that you can apply onto your equipment. They give you a mighty and mystical look, that’ll strike fear onto the eyes of your enemies and admiration onto your allies’. Awesome, aren’t they? Whenever you get an aura from me, you can take them to Leprechaun and he’ll apply it to your equipment. But be aware that only the chest piece of your equipment can receive an aura effect and it also does not work on costumes, you hear me? 

That covers pretty much everything about our services. Be sure to drop by when you have the time to!"

Cheers for Years	Cheers for Years	Report to Anni after getting rid of the designated number of Baby Porings around the statue of Ignatz Gaebolg.	"I’ve heard of all the work you’ve done! Well, who hasn’t!? Your name is known across the kingdom!

I’m glad to finally meet you, <charname>. Let’s take this chance to celebrate and remember another year of your victories!
I do hope you’ll share your stories.  But, for now, I have a special request for you. Do you remember how your story began? Haha.. it was quite a while ago!
Perhaps a reminder is in order?  Well then! 
*clears throat*
… What did I say about sneaking out of class?! Don’t tell me Zeras taught you to do that! 
Hmph… I have had enough from you. As a punishment, you will take care of those wretched Baby Porings vandalizing the statue of Ignatz Gaebolg, great ancestor of the Rune Midgarts Kingdom. 
What is Kalain thinking, leaving those Baby Porings roaming around the front yard? 
Well, what are you waiting for? Get rid of those Baby Porings!
[Warning: Accepting this quest will teleport you to the Elemento Academy.]"			"Hello, <charname>!

The Elemento Acadamey certainly did produce some amazing soldiers.
I suppose what I mean is… I’m proud of what you’ve become, <charname>.

The Second Legend	The Second Legend	Report to Versary after gathering a Dimensional Flower.	"Looking back… it really makes you think, doesn’t it? Your story began here, but our story, our legend, goes back so much farther. 
Odin… Did you know that Porings are formed from the sweat of Odin? They’re eternal! These Porings are older than you or I, though they don’t look it! Porings don’t wrinkle, they don’t age, and they never die! If you defeat a Poring it will just re-form. It’s magic!
Odin’s betrayal incited Freyja’s rage. She aimed to destroy all he had created. The Day of Despair… *sigh*
Midgard was on the brink of extinction. Thanks to the courage and wisdom of heroes like you, she was sealed away so that we could restore peace.
This is the stuff of legends, <charname>.  The Second Legend began with you.

911010120:
[Lunar Festival] Mistletoe: Not Just for Kissing	[Lunar Festival] Mistletoe: Not Just for Kissing	Listen to Austri’s story of Baldur.	"You look confused. Let me explain.
Long, long ago, before the Ragnarok, lived a god by the name of Baldur. Son of Odin and Frig, Baldur was the god of joy, innocence, and light.  
Baldur had no real power, so Frigg made every creature in the world swear to never harm him. 
Thinking him invincible, the gods enjoyed him as a target for knife-throwing and archery.
Don’t give me that look. I know. It’s questionable parenting.  "			"Where was I? Oh, yes…
A malicious trickster was jealous of Baldur and discovered a way to kill him. 
The only thing that had never taken the oath to not harm Baldur was a small mistletoe tree. The trickster found that tree and carved a missile from its bough. 
He tricked Hodur, Baldur’s blind brother, into shooting the projectile at that poor innocent god and… well, the rest is history.
Mistletoe returning to Midgard now? It’s a bad omen—or worse. Perhaps it’s a sign that someone is up to their old tricks."
